name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), domain=chapter (defined in field/chpost.c, written by per-chapter post_action handlers + battle-end check), descriptor event_or_battle_end_code accurately captures the dual use (chapter-event interrupt OR battle win/lose outcome) and 'code' reflects the small enum-like scalar (0/1/2). No Ghidra address residue. Verified semantics across all writers/readers match the name.
purpose: Shared turn-cycle / chapter event-and-battle-end status code that the top-level game loop (main) and the battle turn cycle read to decide whether to continue the battle, end/clear the chapter, or advance to the next chapter.
logic_summary: A 4-byte scalar holding 0/1/2. Written by fd2_check_battle_end_condition (standard win/lose: 2=all enemies dead, 1=protagonist dead, 0=continue), by the per-chapter fd2_chapter_NN_post_action handlers (chapter-specific win/lose/scripted-event overrides, values 1 and 2), by fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter (reset to 0 at chapter start), and by main (loop-level reset to 0). Read by main to dispatch the top-level outcome (1 -> play chapter-clear fanfare then reset; 2 -> run chapter end handler + transition menu + init next chapter then reset) and by the gates in fd2_run_full_turn_cycle / fd2_npc_turn_phase_team1 / fd2_enemy_turn_phase_team0 (NPC/enemy/new-turn phases proceed only while value == 0). Disassembly confirms every access is a full 32-bit MOV/CMP dword ptr [0x53ECC].
element_semantics: Single scalar status code. 0 = none / battle continues (enemies alive, protagonist alive); 1 = chapter cleared / protagonist 蘭 dead -> game over; 2 = chapter switch / all enemies dead -> victory.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (chpost.c) was already accurate, precise and ASCII; no issue. (The Ghidra side, however, had its documentation in the legacy PRE_COMMENT field instead of the convention-mandated PLATE_COMMENT, and that text still referenced the old function name fd2_main.)
notes: Datatype/init verified live: read_memory shows 64 bytes of zero (BSS, .object2, 0-init); disassembly at fd2_check_battle_end_condition shows MOV dword ptr [0x53ECC],0x2 (full dword). is_const=false: many game-side writers (fd2_check_battle_end_condition, fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter, main, ~20 chapter_NN_post_action sites). Name verdict keep. src comment kept (already correct). Ghidra: documentation was misplaced in PRE_COMMENT (legacy) with PLATE empty and a stale 'fd2_main' reference; migrated a refined version into PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline (project data-plate convention) with fd2_main corrected to main, and cleared the legacy PRE_COMMENT. Content kept consistent with the src comment conclusion. No src edit needed, so the only git change is this shard.
